text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...It felt like being trapped in a box.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Everything around me went dark, and I 
couldn't see a thing—I just couldn't run 
the way I wanted to...
choice_data_list: Next time, break out of the box.
...Did you not want to run anymore?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Next time, I'll definitely run my 
own race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Never again— will I ever surrender the 
lead to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, it's the exact opposite. If 
things stay like this, I'll just be 
feeling restless forever..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I want to race again as soon as possible. 
And next time... I will definitely stay in 
the lead until the end.
